links.outcome: Downstream consequences of HMM-PDMP classification thresholds on street opioid escalation and overdose
links.effect: HMM thresholds 0.2 and 0.4 reduced illegitimate prescriptions by 44.30% and 43.45% but increased transitions to street opioids by 105.43% and 94.97%; medical overdose changed little.
links.quote: Specifically, the HMM-aided PDMP precipitates 105.43% and 94.97% increases in transitions to street options for HMM thresholds of 0.2 and 0.4, respectively.
